messages:
Olivia (prod): Quick sync — we need to finalize recruitment & feedback touchpoints for the Private pilot (VPC/on-prem). Goal: 6 partners, 6-week pilot, clear launch criteria. Thoughts?
Sam (eng): Capacity looks OK from infra side; can support 6 small clusters. Need to confirm quantization/driver versions per partner. ETA for onboarding docs?
Tara (solutions): @Olivia I can own outreach + onboarding runbook. Will draft outreach email + intake form by EOD Tue. Suggest we require a 'staging dataset' + 1 integration engineer per partner.
Kevin (devex): DevEx note — please add a short "success checklist" card in Console onboarding flow so partners can self-report. Also want sample telemetry hooks to capture latency/cost.
Leah (research): Feedback loops: weekly async survey + 2 live sessions (kickoff + mid-pilot). We'll run automated evals on a curated prompt set weekly and surface regressions.
Olivia (prod): Proposed launch criteria: 1) Stability: <1% error rate for 7d; 2) SLO: p95 latency <300ms on typical requests; 3) Quality: automated eval pass rate >=85%; 4) Adoption: 3 partners hitting >5k tokens/day. Agree?
Sam (eng): Latency target might be tight for some on-prem GPUs depending on partner infra. Suggest allowing a 'pilot-relaxed' mode at 500ms for initial run but we should measure and report both.
Tara (solutions): Incentives thought: $5k credit + 6 hours of SE support + opt-in case study. Makes recruitment easier.
Olivia (prod): Recruitment priority: regulated fin/health + platform infra orgs that need VPC. @Leah can you draft 5 screening questions we can use in the intake form?
Leah (research): Yes — will post screening Qs here shortly. Also adding a data sensitivity checkbox and minimum infra checklist.
Kevin (devex): One potential blocker: private HSM/KMS integration steps differ partner-to-partner. @Sam can you surface the minimum KMS/HSM reqs we should document? I'll link into the runbook.
Sam (eng): On it — will post a short compatibility matrix + minimum reqs tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Reminder — kickoff meeting created Wed 10am PT; calendar invite sent to thread.
Olivia (prod): Great — I'll consolidate notes into a one-pager after kickoff and post the intake form link. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
